title: V's Lifepath: Nomad (Ex-Bakker from the Badlands)
content: As a Nomad, V left the fractured Bakker clan after its absorption by Snake Nation and crossed the border with Jackie while smuggling a prized Arasaka corporate iguana. Mechanical know-how with convoys, nomad radio frequencies, and deep wariness of walled megacities provide recurring edges in the Badlands and dealings with the Aldecaldos.

title: V's Lifepath: Streetkid (Streets of Heywood & El Coyote Cojo)
content: Raised on the streets of Heywood and recently back from a bitter stint in Atlanta, the Streetkid knows gang hierarchies, street chems, fixer rules like Padre's or Kirk's, and the unspoken codes of El Coyote Cojo firsthand—and has had a feel for the real pulse of the street since childhood.

title: V's Lifepath: Corpo (Arasaka Counterintelligence)
content: A former Arasaka Counterintelligence operative working under Arthur Jenkins out of Corpo Plaza. After being betrayed and stripped of corporate implants during a dirty internal power struggle against Susan Abernathy, V was rescued by Jackie at Lizzie's. That sharp instinct for contract traps, bureaucracy, and corporate paranoia opens multiple tactical doors.

title: Prologue: The Rescue (Sandra Dorsett) & The Ripperdoc (Viktor)
content: V and Jackie raid a Scavenger haunt in Watson to extract Sandra Dorsett and reconnect her jammed biomonitor for Trauma Team. Afterward in Little China, Viktor Vektor fronts you your Kiroshi optics and a Ballistic Coprocessor on credit (it's well worth paying back the 21,000 eddies later) right before you meet Dex DeShawn.

title: Act 1: The Pickup (All Foods, Flathead, Meredith Stout, and Brick)
content: To recover the Flathead bot from All Foods, you have several routes: meet Militech agent Meredith Stout beforehand to take her malware-infected credchip (you can crack the shard first or tip off Royce, later determining whether you gain access to the iconic Sir John Phallustiff or run into Anthony Gilchrist's warning), and check the control room to see how to free Brick by either detonating or disarming his mine.

title: Act 1: The Information (Evelyn's Penthouse Braindance)
content: In the basement of Lizzie's Bar, you must scrub through Evelyn's braindance recording from the Konpeki Plaza penthouse across all three layers: scan security access points and the chilled Relic container on the Thermal layer, listen in on Yorinobu's corporate phone call on Audio, and pinpoint drones and cameras on Visual.

title: Act 1: The Heist at Konpeki Plaza (Secret Loot: Satori & Iguana Egg)
content: During the Konpeki Plaza infiltration, search Yorinobu's penthouse thoroughly before escaping: the iconic pistol Kongou sits beside the bed, an Iguana Egg you can hatch later in Megabuilding H10 rests inside the terrarium log, and if you climb up through the back skylight onto the AV helipad after the incident, you can grab both the iconic katana Satori and Saburo's Nehan knife.

title: Act 2: Playing for Time (Solo Meeting with Takemura at Tom's Diner)
content: After Takemura's rescue from the landfill and Viktor's clinic, V meets solo with Goro Takemura at Tom's Diner in Little China. Takemura proposes a tactical alliance against Yorinobu Arasaka to eventually bring the truth of Saburo's murder to Hanako, while V fights to survive the Relic. That sit-down opens three parallel leads—tracking Evelyn Parker starting at Lizzie's Bar, locating Anders Hellman through Rogue at the Afterlife, and later reaching Hanako Arasaka—and lifts the Watson NCPD lockdown.

title: Act 2 (Judy Branch): Automatic Love, Clouds, Fingers, and Disasterpiece
content: Tracking Evelyn leads to Clouds in Japantown (choose Skye or Angel—watch closely so you don't mix up the two names—then snag the VIP password or sneak in to interrogate Woodman). From there, the trail takes you to sleazy ripperdoc Fingers on Jig-Jig Street and down into the Scavengers' underground power plant alongside Judy.

title: Act 2 (Panam Branch): Ghost Town & Bringing Down the Kang Tao AV
content: Rogue connects you with Panam Palmer out in the Badlands. After reclaiming her Thorton Mackinaw in Rocky Ridge (and optionally settling scores with Nash in the cave where a free black Caliburn later spawns), you trigger an EMP blast from the power station to shoot down Kang Tao's corporate AV and capture Anders Hellman.

title: Act 2 (Pacifica Branch): Voodoo Boys, the GIM, and the NetWatch Agent
content: Looking to reach Alt Cunningham beyond the Blackwall, Placide sends you into the Grand Imperial Mall (GIM) against the Animals and their boss Sasquatch (aim for the glowing power pack on her back). Inside the cinema, you can cut a deal with NetWatch agent Bryce Mosley to purge Placide's double-crossing virus—radically altering everyone's fate in Transmission.

title: Act 2 (Takemura Branch): Arasaka Industrial Park, Dashi Parade & Rescue
content: After infiltrating the Arasaka float warehouse (where the iconic Shingen Mark V SMG sits inside a shipping container), during the Dashi Parade you take out three snipers and defeat Oda. Watch out during the hotel ambush in 'Search and Destroy': instead of fleeing straight downstairs, you can jump or climb back up to the upper floor to save Takemura.

title: Nocturne Op55N1 — The Point of No Return at Embers
content: Stepping into the elevator at Embers to meet Hanako triggers the endgame sequence, locking out open side quests until you finish the epilogue (after which the game returns you right outside the club with bonus rewards). Be sure to wrap up Panam, Judy, River, Kerry, and Johnny's questlines beforehand to unlock every ending.

title: Paths to Mikoshi: The Devil, The Star, The Sun, and (Don't Fear) The Reaper
content: Who stands beside V on Misty's rooftop decides your path: siding with Hanako leads to the bleak Arasaka ending (The Devil); calling Panam and the Aldecaldos launches an underground assault toward The Star; handing control to Johnny and Rogue leads to The Sun in orbit; and waiting 5 real-time minutes on the rooftop after choosing the right oil-field dialogue unlocks the solo suicide run, (Don't Fear) The Reaper.

quest_ids: With a Little Help from My Friends
title: Aldecaldo Chain (Panam): Rescuing Saul, the Train, and the Basilisk Panzer
keywords_en: with a little help from my friends
content: After helping track down Hellman, Panam calls for backup to rescue Saul from the Wraiths during a lethal sandstorm ('Riders on the Storm', where you earn the suppressed Overwatch sniper rifle). Later, you raid a Militech convoy alongside the Aldecaldo veterans to klep the Basilisk hovertank.

title: Judy Chain: Taking Over Clouds (Maiko) & Diving in Laguna Bend
content: After rescuing Evelyn, Judy tries to liberate Clouds by rallying Tom and Roxanne against the Tyger Claws bosses and opportunistic Maiko (to keep Judy's trust and unlock 'Pyramid Song', turn down Maiko's dirty payout or handle the takeover carefully). The arc culminates in a deeply immersive, nostalgic scuba dive through submerged Laguna Bend.

title: Chippin' In — The Ebunike Freighter, Porsche 911, and the Oil Fields
content: Aboard the Ebunike freighter with Rogue, you recover Johnny's Malorian 3516 pistol and his Porsche 911 (if you spare Grayson or grab the container key after confronting him). Later, at his unmarked grave in the northern oil fields, speaking candidly ('The guy who saved my life' and 'Nah, fucked that up too') defines your bond and unlocks the secret ending.

title: Kerry Eurodyne Chain: The Samurai Reunion Gig & Us Cracks
content: Unlocked after 'Chippin' In', you join Johnny and Kerry to reunite Samurai for a legendary gig at the Red Dirt and sabotage Us Cracks' gear—only to discover that both acts' corporate manager was behind the feud, kicking off wild follow-up quests aboard the Seamurai yacht and with Blue Moon.

title: River Ward Chain: I Fought the Law & The Hunt (Edgewood Farm)
content: After helping the Peralezes and River untangle the murky conspiracy around Weldon Holt and the Red Queen's Race ('I Fought the Law'), River calls in desperation for help analyzing his nephew Randy's braindances and rescuing him from Edgewood Farm—ringed with mines and turrets—before 'Peter Pan' kills him.

title: Dream On — The Peralezes' Secret Surveillance Room
content: Inside Jefferson and Elizabeth Peralez's luxury penthouse, a concealed electronic panel near the study opens into a hidden surveillance room wired up to a rooftop transmitter. Chasing down the cloaked SSI van reveals someone is rewriting their memories and neural pathways—leaving you to decide whether telling Jefferson the truth protects or shatters their lives.

title: The Beast in Me — Claire's Street Races & Peter Sampson
content: Afterlife bartender Claire Russell recruits you as her driver for four street races across Night City behind the wheel of her truck Beast (or your best ride). Ahead of the grand finale, she reveals she's hunting Peter Sampson over her husband Dean's death—talking her down and sparing Sampson nets you both vehicles.

title: Cyberpsycho Sightings for Regina Jones (Non-Lethal Tips)
content: There are 17 Cyberpsycho Sightings scattered across Night City in the base game. Regina asks you to take targets alive to study real therapies: even if you use standard weapons down to the last 1% HP and finish with a Pax mod, bare-knuckle punches, a non-lethal rear takedown, or Short Circuit / Overheat without hitting them while downed, they survive and she pays the full bonus.

title: Tarot (Fool on the Hill), Epistrophy (Delamain), and Sinnerman
content: Three unforgettable quests off the beaten path: scanning all 20 Tarot murals across the city for Misty in 'Fool on the Hill'; rounding up the 7 rogue Delamain cabs in 'Epistrophy' (each riffing on psychological and pop-culture tropes before you choose to merge, reset, or free their core); and the haunting 'Sinnerman' gig with Joshua Stephenson and Rachel Casich.

title: Phantom Liberty: Sneaking Into Dogtown & the Chimera Mech
content: After Songbird contacts you outside the Pacifica stadium, you slip through the hidden parking garage scaffolding to rescue President Myers from the wreckage of Space Force One. Dropping into the underground museum forces you to destroy the colossal Chimera mech by targeting its glowing weak-point plates—be sure to grab the Chimera Core afterward.

title: Phantom Liberty: The Black Sapphire Gala & Firestarter's Turning Point
content: At the Black Sapphire, you infiltrate Kurt Hansen's gala, play roulette against netrunner twins Aurore and Aymeric Cassel, and prep to impersonate them using a behavioral faceplate. Inside the stadium during 'Firestarter', the exact moment you deploy the Icebreaker or side with Songbird permanently splits Phantom Liberty's final act.

title: Phantom Liberty: The Moon (The Killing Moon) vs. Cynosure (Somewhat Damaged)
content: Helping Songbird leads to the frantic battle at the Morro Rock orbital spaceport ('The Killing Moon'); trying to capture her alongside Reed sends you into a terrifying cat-and-mouse chase against the invulnerable Cerberus mech inside the ruined Cynosure bunker ('Somewhat Damaged', where you can find the unique crafting specs for the Blackwall-infused Erebus SMG or Canto cyberdeck).

title: Dogtown Activities: Airdrops, Muamar Vehicle Contracts & Relic Perks
content: Inside Dogtown, keep your ears open for smuggling AVs and red smoke flares marking Airdrops packed with Tier 5++ chrome, missed iconic weapons from the stadium vendor, and Cyberware Capacity Shards. Meanwhile, hidden Militech terminals unlock Relic skill tree upgrades for your optics and arms, and El Capitán pays out on fast-paced vehicle theft contracts.

title: Rentable Apartments, Nibbles the Cat & Hatching the Iguana
content: Beyond your starter apartment in Megabuilding H10, the EZEstates net lets you rent pads in Northside, Japantown, The Glen, and Corpo Plaza. Sleeping or showering grants an XP/regeneration buff lasting one real-time hour and coffee boosts extra stamina, while cat food near H10 lets you adopt hairless Nibbles and the lounge bowl hatches your Iguana Egg.

title: Side Job: Heroes — Jackie Welles's Ofrenda at El Coyote Cojo
content: If V sent Jackie Welles's body to his family after Konpeki Plaza, Mama Welles invites V to El Coyote Cojo in Vista del Rey for his Ofrenda alongside Misty and the Valentinos. Choosing an item from Jackie's garage to lay on the altar honors his memory, earns Mama Welles's gratitude, and unlocks the keys to Jackie's Arch motorcycle.

title: The Gift & The Gig — T-Bug's Ping Daemon & Wakako Okada's Reward
content: Early Watson follow-ups leave two key stepping stones: in 'The Gift,' V visits Yoko Tsukino's netrunner shop in Kabuki to pick up the tactical Ping quickhack T-Bug left behind before Konpeki Plaza; in 'The Gig,' V meets fixer Wakako Okada on Jig-Jig Street in Japantown to collect the promised payout for rescuing Sandra Dorsett alongside a smart-targeting hand tattoo reward.
